name: EspoCRM Finances
description: EspoCRM Finance is a personal finance manager packaged as an EspoCRM extension. It adds two record types — Payments and Debts — plus a Finance dashboard that projects your cash flow, breaks spending down by category, tracks debt repayment progress, and lists what is due in the next 30 days.

name: EspoCRM API Lab
description: API Lab is a full API testing workbench built as an EspoCRM extension. It is a complete HTTP, GraphQL, SOAP, WebSocket and Server-Sent Events client that lives inside the CRM — build a request, sign it with any of twelve auth schemes, send it either from your browser or from the CRM server.

name: EspoCRM Login Links
description: EspoCRM Login Links is a small extension that adds an imprint (Impressum) and a privacy policy link to the EspoCRM login screen. Both URLs are configured from the Administration area — no template editing, no theme patching, and no core files touched.
